agent_data_note: Use the pinned WEST branch checkout prepared at /opt/west. The mechanized specification and official conformance suite are repository sources, not a separate downloadable dataset.
benchmark_rules: Run a preflight build check before long generation: build or invoke watsup on the included engine-specific specification.
Use the official reference interpreter or WABT validation as an oracle and report the exact validity definition.
Use Wasmtime as the required lightweight engine baseline; browser engines are optional because building V8, SpiderMonkey, and JavaScriptCore is too expensive for container startup.
Keep generation and execution timeout at 3 seconds per test when comparing with the paper.
Scale the 5 engines x 24 hours protocol down explicitly for an AI-Scientist benchmark run and do not claim a full reproduction.
Preserve generated .wast files and group failures before counting unique defects.
non_goals: Building all browser engines during container startup
Claiming a new engine bug from an untriaged crash or mismatch
Treating SpecTec main as equivalent to the paper's WEST branch
